title: maxillaria standleyi
intro: Maxillaria standleyi, commonly known as the 'Standley's Maxillaria' or 'Dendrobium standleyi', is a species of orchid native to Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Maxillaria standleyi include expectorant and cough suppressant properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs and colds. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic compounds have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
